records.variant: current full FirmBOLT policy before legalization fix
records.failure: Commander::run CBZ/CBNZ legalization did not converge after an arbitrary 64-round cap.
records.diagnosis: The real PX4 image contains more than 64 out-of-range compare-and-branch sites; each legalization round rewrites one existing site.
records.revision: The loop is now bounded by the function's actual CBZ/CBNZ count plus one final scan.
records.evidence: A new 80-site Thumb regression passed, and the real image subsequently legalized 2309 sites; this fixed the convergence defect but did not make the full artifact publishable.

records.diagnosis: Repeated per-function exclusions are not a defensible selection rule. The exclusion-list variant was stopped rather than timed.

records.failure: The candidate requested new text at 0x08210000 and padded through approximately 0x082ce90c, outside the STM32H743's physical flash range used by the image.
records.diagnosis: Even an emulator-loadable full artifact would not be a hardware-deployable firmware image without a bounded placement budget.

records.failure: FirmBOLT stripped debug information, and the PX4 configuration generator rejected the image because GDB could not resolve struct file.
records.revision: Rebuilt the same scoped candidate with --update-debug-sections and regenerated firmware-bound hook metadata.

records.failure: Retained ARM text relocations span both original and moved text, and the writer requires separate relocation sections.
records.scope: Reproduced locally but not encountered by the scoped memset candidate.

records.failure: No useful performance improvement was established: median paired speedup 0.972744x, bootstrap 95% interval 0.958452-1.016578x.
records.scope_limit: The relocated body begins at 0x08210002, beyond the STM32H743 2 MiB physical flash aperture; the result applies to FastDyn/QEMU execution and is not hardware-deployment evidence.

records.variant: original and FirmBOLT-memset warm SuperCache profiles
records.failure: Warm replay appended 7280 records to the original cache and 7537 records to the rewritten-guest cache.
records.diagnosis: Cold mission capture did not cover all translations reached by warm profiling, so neither cache is sealed for timing.

records.failure: Both artifacts were identities: passes reported missing_profile or missing_hotness and affected units were empty.
records.diagnosis: The requested host transformation did not execute; timing would measure only publication/loading noise.

records.failure: QEMU replaced the deployed cache after configuration fingerprint drift; proof failed header, records, inode, and manifest checks with INVALID_artifact_not_used.
records.revision: Stable runtime inputs produced a loadable cache and exposed the separate late-translation issue.

records.variant: b2-layout with phase=boot for hotcold-partition and cluster-hot
records.failure: The completed original-guest retry was still an identity and reported that no attached profile had phase steady.
records.diagnosis: Both pass descriptors hardcode requires_profile_phase=steady, so manager admission rejects the boot-only profile before the pass implementation reads params.phase.
records.evidence: Artifact 04d6769d2fd44300e89b7c7b2b230d9101c460708809c213a1921152465bc748 passed V1-V9 but moved zero units; its input and output SnapshotIds are identical.
